-- Effects are declared in `uses` and must also be granted by the host at run time.
fn log_line(msg: Text) -> Unit
  uses [console]
do
  return console.print(msg)
end fn

fn greet(name: Text) -> Unit
  uses [console]
do
  return log_line(text.concat("hello, ", name))
end fn

fn stamp() -> Int
  uses [time.now]
do
  return time.now()
end fn

fn pure_len(t: Text) -> Int
  example pure_len("abc") == 3
do
  return text.len(t)
end fn
